question: not False or ( True ) and True is

segments.text: We need to evaluate the expression: "not False or ( True ) and True".
We need to determine its truth value.
In Python, operator precedence: not has higher precedence than and, which has higher precedence than or.
So parse: not False or (True) and True.
Then we have True or (True) and True.
Next, and has higher precedence than or, so evaluate (True) and True => True.
So expression becomes True or True => True.
The question: "not False or ( True ) and True is".
Likely they want the truth value: True.
